description: Stratta answers civil and structural engineering questions from the norms your own organization has uploaded under its own license, and it answers them with a citation you can check: the exact section path and the page number. Each organization brings its own copies; Stratta hosts no shared corpus and redistributes no standard. The agent opens the table of contents, walks down to the clause that matters, reads it, follows the cross-references that change the answer, and looks at the figure when a load diagram carries the rule. Project dossiers keep the trail of what was retained, what it rests on, and what is still open: the questions of a dossier, their options, their evidence with every citation field, the decision and the remarks left along the way. For a site in Switzerland, the agent can also read the site sheet the app builds from public cantonal and federal registers, with its boreholes and their strata, and open one for an address on the plans that include it. The office's own owners and administrators can file a norm they hold a licence for from their own machine, through the ingestion tools. A new workspace starts with DEMO 001, a fictional document written by Stratta, so the workflow can be tried before any licensed norm is uploaded.

defaultPrompt: List my available norms in Stratta.
Find the cited rule for this engineering question.
Open or update a project dossier.
